description.narrative: The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) Humanitarian Fund applies coordinated approaches in delivering humanitarian assistance across the country. Advancing aid reforms through strategic programming and expanding networks, the Fund supports projects that fall under multiple emergency, recovery, and sustainable development clusters.
